args.title: Use splitFields for header parsing to support quoted column names
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields on the header line instead of a naive .split(",") so that quoted column names (e.g. `"Date","Amount"`) are parsed correctly and do not retain leading/trailing quotes or fail column-count checks.
